en.headline: 3 commits on daily-report repo; 3 issues opened/closed on openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, the user pushed 3 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, adding a daily GitHub activity report feature built on GitHub Pages and SenseTime AI, fixing report submission wording and page issues, and enabling manual date specification via workflow_dispatch in the CI workflow. Additionally, 2 automated commits were made by github-actions[bot] on sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator. The user opened 3 issues on openchamber/openchamber: #4337 flagged that multi-run documentation still referenced a sidebar header button removed in commit d9fbf6b; #4345 noted that the command palette's "Parallel run" item shared the checkbox-multiple icon with the sidebar's "Select sessions" toggle; and #4346 reported that SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passed even though onOpenMultiRun and canOpenMultiRun were removed in d9fbf6b. openchamber-bot[bot] commented on both #4337 and #4345, tracing the root causes and marking them fix-ready. Issue #4337 was subsequently closed by btriapitsyn.

zh.headline: 日报仓库提交3次；openchamber 新开并关闭3个 issue
zh.summary: 2026年10月3日，用户在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 仓库提交了3次代码，新增基于 GitHub Pages 和商汤 AI 的每日 GitHub 活动日报功能，修正了日报提交口径与页面问题，并在 CI 工作流中支持通过 workflow_dispatch 手动指定日期。此外，github-actions[bot] 在 sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-creator 上自动提交了2次。用户在 openchamber/openchamber 上开了3个 issue：#4337 指出多运行文档仍引用了在 d9fbf6b 中被移除的侧边栏头部按钮；#4345 指出命令面板的 "Parallel run" 与侧边栏 "Select sessions" 共用了 checkbox-multiple 图标；#4346 报告 SidebarHeader.test.tsx 在 onOpenMultiRun 和 canOpenMultiRun 被移除后仍然通过。openchamber-bot[bot] 分别在 #4337 和 #4345 上留言，追踪了根因并标记为 fix-ready。随后 #4337 由 btriapitsyn 关闭。
